title: Get Signed in User Details
description: Retrieves details of the currently logged-in user.

query.name: page
query.description: Pass the page number to retrieve records.

query.name: page_size
query.description: Pass the number of records to retrieve on each page.

body.name: id
body.description: Returns the unique ID of the user. This ID is used across Intel Exchange to perform actions.

body.name: first_name
body.description: Returns the first name of the user.

body.name: last_name
body.description: Returns the last name of the user.

body.name: email
body.description: Returns the Intel Exchange associated email address of the user. The user receives all Intel Exchange related emails and information on this email address.

body.name: is_active
body.description: Returns True if the user is active in Intel Exchange, else returns False.

body.name: contact_number
body.description: Returns the contact details, like mobile or telephone number, of the user.

body.name: country_code
body.description: Returns the country code in which the user is located.

body.name: user_id
body.description: Returns the unique ID for the user. This ID is used across Intel Exchange to perform actions.

body.name: created
body.description: Returns the date and time of the creation of the user.

body.name: invited_by
body.description: Returns the details of the user who created this user in Intel Exchange in the form of a dictionary.

body.name: invite_status
body.description: Returns the invitation status of the user, such as Accepted or Invited.

body.name: email_alerts
body.description: Returns True if the user wants to receive email alerts on the Intel Exchange associated email address, else returns False.

body.name: sms_alerts
body.description: Returns True if the user wants to receive SMS alerts on the Intel Exchange associated contact number, else returns False.

body.name: groups
body.description: Returns the list of associated user groups for the user. This includes the group ID and the name of the group.

items.name: id
items.description: Returns the unique ID of the user group.

items.name: name
items.description: Returns the name of the user group.

body.name: allowed_tlp
body.description: Returns the list of allowed TLPs from which a user can access and view threat data. You can access threat data from all TLPs if TLPs are not selected.

body.name: username
body.description: Returns the LDAP username associated with a user.

body.name: image_url
body.description: Return the URL of the image.

body.name: date_joined
body.description: Returns the date and time at which the user was created.

body.name: last_active_session
body.description: Returns the last active date and time of the user on the platform.

body.name: admin_component
body.description: Returns the list of components that are part of the admin component in Intel Exchange. Possible values are `superadmin`, `user_management`, `role_and_permission`, `configuration`, `third_party`, `api_integrations`, `certification`, `object_labels`, and `enrichment_management`.

body.name: component
body.description: Returns the components/modules the user has access to.

items.description: Access to the Intel Exchange dashboard UI.
Access to email threat feed settings.
Access to threat intel source configuration.
Access to product version and license info.
Access to actions configured for indicators.
Access to risk score customization settings.
Access to user activity audit logs.

body.name: permission
body.description: Returns the list of specific actions/permissions the user is allowed to perform.

items.description: Add new IOCs to the whitelist.
View user roles and their permissions.

body.name: default_page_size
body.description: Returns the default page size for the user for listing APIs.

body.name: last_login_ip
body.description: Returns the IP address of the user when the user last logged.

body.name: last_login_location
body.description: Returns the geographical location, including country, along with the city of the user as per the last login IP address.
